verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents registrable outbound webhooks and a pull-based Events API, but the evidence ties them only to Directory Sync: directory, group, and user updates. That covers directory-driven user changes, but there is no evidence of webhook or event-stream coverage for AuthKit sign-up or sign-in events. Missing for 10: documented sign-up/sign-in event types, AuthKit user-management events via webhooks or Events API, webhook signing/retry/delivery details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
